units.source_text: 我必须说明一下，我一说这是先生的第一封信，恐怕会让人误以为我和先生之间的书信往来一定很多，事实并非如此。

en.t: I should explain that calling this Sensei's first letter may make it seem as though there was a great deal of correspondence between us, but in fact that was not so.

units.source_text: 先生生前，我只接到过他的两封信。

en.t: While Sensei was alive, I received only two letters from him.

units.source_text: 其中一封就是现在这封简短的回信，另外一封则是先生死前特意给我写的一封很长的遗书。

en.t: One of them was the brief reply I am speaking of now; the other was a very long farewell letter that Sensei deliberately wrote to me before his death.

units.source_text: 由于父亲的病不能太走动，所以下地后，也几乎没到户外去过。

en.t: Because my father's illness kept him from moving around much, even after he was able to get out of bed, he almost never went outdoors.

units.source_text: 只是在一个天气特别暖和的下午，父亲到院子里去了，我怕万一出事，紧跟在他身旁。

en.t: Only on one especially warm afternoon did my father go out into the garden, and, fearing something might happen, I stayed close beside him.

units.source_text: 为了安全起见，我让父亲扶着我的肩走路，父亲笑了笑，没有扶。

en.t: For safety, I told my father to hold on to my shoulder as he walked, but he smiled and did not take hold.
